notes: Only SIG_TIME+RDrop; original RAW_HZ/normalaug/LS.01/default head joint/original U and ownEMA fixed. No gradient projection, inherited model, new teacher, augmentation or optimizer changes.

FULL exact original native RDrop. LOCAL detaches only confidence mass multiplying conditional relation. SAME/CROSS transport only the conditional term; binary term remains self. W and features remain trainable through CE and all loss graphs.

Per identity first2 samples per RX with at least2; need at least2 eligible RX. SAME swaps local pair;CROSS pairs opposite positions in2M selected indices ordered by RX-group first appearance; exactly1peer like SAME. Remaining samples self. Selected count and row/column sums match, no RNG draws.

Zero relation gradient at true-class raw logit is a local property, not probability/calibration/encoder/AdamW invariance. No global novelty claim: KL partition has DKD precedent; specific hypothesis is balanced cross-RX evidence transfer with self confidence.
